# Richard Buchanan

Richard Buchanan is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2018.

Richard Buchanan has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2018 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/richard-buchanan#e43)

  Elected as Connétable of St Ouen unopposed.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/richard-buchanan/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zGNKjhJJgcQ)

## Election History

### 2018 Connétables Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Ouen](https://flow.je/elections/st-ouen) (1 seat), 16th May 2018.

**Richard Buchanan was elected as Connétable of St Ouen in 2018 unopposed**.
